applicability: Supplied process mean/std, spec limits, gage R&R standard deviation, and declared Cpk/%GRR acceptance thresholds
assumptions: Process output is normally distributed with the supplied mean and standard deviation
Supplied process/gage standard deviations are exact, not estimated from a specific sample
Part and gage variation combine in quadrature (AIAG MSA total-variation convention)
excluded: Full ANOVA gage R&R study from raw part/operator/trial data
